The plate is a square plate of about 22-24 cm. The scrambled egg covers roughly 10 × 11 cm and is about 2-3 cm high in a loose pile. That gives a volume of roughly 150-200 ml, and loosely packed egg would be about 0.6-0.7 g/ml, so about 110 g. Scrambled egg cooked with some fat is about 160-170 kcal per 100 g. A little oil sheen is visible, but it is already included in that value.
